_about: TASK-186 relabel backfill change set: every posting whose stored role_class / role_rule / department_hint would change under the TASK-186 classifier, old to new.

Computed offline from the vacancy-landscape export (all 3870 status=open postings, golden postings.description, 2026-10-01) by replaying classify_role(title, desc=description) and department_hint(title, description) with the base code (9c6f158) and with this branch. hauptberuf, offer_kind and nursing_section_confirmed are not in the export and were replayed as empty.

'postings' = rows the script writes: role_class/role_rule where 'role' is present, department_hint where 'department' is present. 'quote' = at most 160 chars of the posting that made the rule fire (emails and phone numbers scrubbed).

'not_pushed' = rows the script never touches: drift_role / drift_department are rows whose stored value already differs from the replay WITHOUT this change (stored by the crawler with signals the export lacks, e.g. nursing_section_confirmed or the board CSV 'board:*' rules, or by older code); listed so they are not mistaken for TASK-186 changes. department_already_at_new_value = stored hint already equals the new one.
'reading' = hand reading of every row that is outside its own judge positive set (S1 Ausbildung, S2 non-nursing job, S3 not a vacancy, S4 specialty hidden).
